notes.title: DEFINITIVE UPDATE!
notes.notes:
https://i.imgur.com/TBDpgNgl.png

The development of Vikings Hnefatafl: Kings of the Dark Age has come to an end with this content-filled update!
If need arises, patches can still be released. New content however will not be added.

UPDATE CONTENTS


Four new maps for Custom Battles: 1x small SP/1x large SP/1x small MP/1x large MP
new Statistics for post-battle
larger windowed mode size
Campaign cutscenes now skippable

notes.title: Update Notes For Nov 12
notes.notes: a bunch of new Custom Maps have been added to both single- and two-player Custom Battle modes! The maps have a 50-50 ratio of Small and Large Board sizes.
